runtime_rule: These cases define the future executable denominator. They are not PASS claims and must be executed only after the rebuild constitution is reconciled and the exact implementation slice is materialized.

cases.obligation: Learning is the sole writer of learner-specific self-regulation observations.
Self-regulation state cannot mutate Curriculum strategy/instruction definitions.
Self-regulation state cannot mutate mastery, retention or transfer directly.
Generic telemetry/analytics cannot create canonical self-regulation facts.
Raw chat/provider/webhook metadata cannot become semantic learner authority.
Shared identity/privacy/authorization truth remains externally owned and referenced.
Existing SelfConfidenceObservation remains a bounded self-report signal and is not replaced by a second confidence writer.
No psychology/personality/mental-health authority is created by this capability.
A valid PLAN observation can be recorded against exact owner-valid learning context.
A valid MONITOR observation can be recorded against exact owner-valid learning context.
A valid EVALUATE/reflection observation can be recorded against exact owner-valid learning context.
A valid STRATEGY_USE observation can distinguish learner-selected, system-suggested and modeled strategy standing.
Missing plan/monitor/evaluate observation remains UNKNOWN rather than an imputed learner fact.
Reflection quality alone cannot change competence/mastery standing.
Strategy selection/use alone cannot change competence/mastery standing.
A learner may revise strategy without destructive rewrite of prior strategy-use history.
Plan-monitor-evaluate checkpoints do not require a prompt after every micro-action.
Same exact history plus same exact policy produces deterministic projected self-regulation standing.
Learner-declared confusion may be recorded only as bounded context and not incompetence evidence.
Learner-declared effort may be recorded only as bounded context and not mastery/non-mastery evidence.
Learner-declared task value/relevance may be recorded only as bounded context and not learning-gain evidence.
Missing learner-declared context remains UNKNOWN rather than zero/negative.
Model-extracted context from free text preserves extraction/confirmation standing and is not mislabeled direct declaration.
Automatic emotion/mental-state inference from camera/physiology/chat behavior is rejected as default canonical Learning truth.
A learner can correct a declared observation while prior history and correction lineage remain visible.
Self-confidence, confusion, effort or task value cannot bypass an evidence/mastery gate.
Support reduction requires exact policy plus current learner context; self-report alone cannot force fading.
Scaffold fading is reversible when the learner becomes stuck or requests more support.
Learner request for less support is treated as preference/context and does not prove independent capability.
Learner request for more support cannot lower mastery by itself.
Authorized accommodation/assistive technology is not automatically classified as scaffolding that should fade.
AI/tool assistance remains visible when interpretation of independence depends on it.
Independent-performance evidence is required where the intended construct explicitly requires independence.
Repeated supported success alone cannot prove readiness for unsupported independent performance.
Prompt/scaffold frequency can be reduced without deleting historical support-condition evidence.
A learner can skip a non-mandatory reflection prompt when policy permits without semantic failure.
Learner Model can project self-regulation observations with observed/derived/inferred/unknown/stale/contradicted standing as applicable.
Learner Model cannot write source self-regulation observations to justify a projection.
Adaptive policy may consume self-regulation state but cannot make an ineligible action eligible.
Self-regulation state cannot bypass prerequisite, assessment-integrity, safety or authorization restrictions.
Adaptive recommendation can offer an eligible planning/reflection/strategy action with an exact reason trace.
A learner override/strategy choice remains preference/action context and not competence evidence.
First valid self-regulation observation appends exactly once with stable semantic identity.
Same operation identity plus same semantic payload replays the original semantic result without duplication.
Same operation identity plus different semantic payload fails deterministically.
Later observations do not destructively overwrite earlier learner declarations or strategy history.
Transport retry/offline replay cannot create duplicate semantic observations.
Canonical self-regulation state excludes unrelated identity/device/provider/raw-chat data under minimization rules.
Changed executable bytes require fresh exact-subject qualification; design freeze or historical PASS cannot transfer.
Software qualification cannot be labeled evidence that self-regulation support improves educational outcomes; effectiveness requires separate empirical evaluation.
